import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];

    static String toString(BigInteger num) {
        if (num.equals(BigInteger.ZERO))
            return "0";
        String res = num.toString();
        return res;
    }

    static void solve(List<Integer> variables, int base, BigInteger[] ans) {
        int cur, until;

        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2 = new ArrayList<>();

        int[] curRef = {base};
        int[] untilRef = new int[1];

        // Recursive lambda simulation
        class Brute {
            void brute(int pos) {
                if (pos == untilRef[0]) {
                    rem1.add(curRef[0]);
                    return;
                }

                int oldcur = curRef[0];
                for (int t = 0; t < 10; ++t) {
                    brute(pos + 1);
                    curRef[0] += variables.get(pos);
                    if (curRef[0] >= MOD)
                        curRef[0] -= MOD;
                }
                curRef[0] = oldcur;
            }
        }

        Brute brute = new Brute();

        untilRef[0] = variables.size() / 2;
        curRef[0] = base;
        brute.brute(0);

        rem2 = new ArrayList<>(rem1);
        curRef[0] = 0;
        untilRef[0] = variables.size();
        brute.brute(variables.size() / 2);

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2)
            totalrsum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= MOD)
                --j;

            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(a * (long) rem2.size() + totalrsum - (rem2.size() - 1 - j) * (long) MOD));
        }
    }

    static long count_with_prefix(String s, long n, String n_str) {
        long ans = 0;

        long s_val = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray())
            s_val = 10 * s_val + ch - '0';

        for (int len = s.length(); len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            if (len < n_str.length())
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            else {
                int t = s.compareTo(n_str.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (t < 0)
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                else if (t == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - s_val * pw10[n_str.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());

        StringBuilder n_strBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        long t = n;
        while (t != 0) {
            n_strBuilder.append((char) ('0' + t % 10));
            t /= 10;
        }
        String n_str = n_strBuilder.reverse().toString();

        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i)
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        BigInteger[] ans = {BigInteger.ZERO};
        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < n_str.length() && firstdiff < len; ++firstdiff) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst.append(n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; ++lastdig) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (lastdig == n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;
                    if (len == n_str.length() && lastdig > n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst.toString() + (char) ('0' + lastdig);

                    long base = 0;
                    String tmp = "";
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); ++pos) {
                        char startDig = (pos == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char dig = startDig; dig < curstp.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                            base += count_with_prefix(tmp + dig, n, n_str);

                        tmp += curstp.charAt(pos);
                    }
                    base += len - 1; // all strict prefixes are also smaller

                    // (sum ai xi + base) mod p
                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    tmp = curstp;
                    for (int pos = curstp.length(); pos < len; ++pos) {
                        variables.add((int) (count_with_prefix(tmp + '0', n, n_str) % MOD));
                        tmp += '0';
                    }

                    base += 1; // 1-based, not 0-based
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t = 0; t < variables.size(); ++t)
                        variables.set(variables.size() - 1 - t, (int) ((variables.get(variables.size() - 1 - t) - pw10[t] % MOD) % MOD));

                    base %= MOD;
                    if (base < 0)
                        base += MOD;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (val < 0)
                            val += MOD;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    solve(variables, (int) base, ans);
                }
            }
        }

        // special case, numbers that are a prefix of N:
        long cur = 0;
        StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            curst.append(n_str.charAt(len - 1));
            cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1; // 1-based
            String tmp = "";
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); ++pos) {
                char startDig = (pos == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char dig = startDig; dig < curst.charAt(pos); ++dig)
                    val += count_with_prefix(tmp + dig, n, n_str);

                tmp += curst.charAt(pos);
            }
            val += len - 1; // all strict prefixes are also smaller

            val -= cur;
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0)
                val += MOD;

            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        ans[0] = ans[0].mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007));
        pw.println(toString(ans[0]));
        pw.close();
    }
}
